new_claim.title: Finite-critical ordinary-node Gaussian exclusion by stationary action and complete regular rank
new_claim.scope: For the ternary common ordinary-node pair P=T(uv+h)+a*u^3+d*v^3+b*u^2+c*v^2+e*u+f*v+k and full nondegenerate affine Gaussian q with m=q_TT!=0,assume NO leading node has BOTH F2(w)=0 and q2(w)=0,and assume the AFFINE CRITICAL SET OF P IS FINITE. Then P is not pure;more strongly EVERY original marked Gaussian Phi_A is zero or is not a finite exponential-polynomial. All a/d zero faces,all isolated degeneracies and coincident actions are retained,covering irreducible nodal,transverse line-conic and triangle members at this stated finite-critical scope. Universal identity along an algebraic critical branch of S=P/r-q is q=-S-r*Sprime. Ordinary-node coercivity at a single limiting direction forces every escape toward a node with F2=0,and no-frame makes q2 nonzero there,so q has a pole;the action therefore has a polar power OTHER than r^-1. No escape can be zero-exponential or a pure alpha/r action;no Morse or escape-scale assumptions. Fixed-r strong tameness gives full generic twisted rank equal to total critical Milnor multiplicity. Locally uniform coercivity and P=r(g+q) on bounded-target fibers give a complete at-most-linear parameter lift,excluding additional finite-target infinity discriminant curves. FIRST ramify ALL critical-value curves to graphs;Roucairol NONRAMIFIED Theorem0.1(2)/Section1.2 and Theorem0.3 then give the nonzero-block ranks,with each conjugate graph and conormal Milnor multiplicity counted even when polar parts coincide. Theorem0.2 monodromy formula/separation assumption is not used. Subtracting these ranks leaves exactly the bounded finite critical points with P=0. Exact local coordinates P=alpha+sw+y^(mu+1),analytic full Gaussian amplitude units,explicit power/Gaussian formal recurrences and polynomial finite-jet separation construct this ENTIRE zero block. Over unramified C((r)) its monodromy has eigenvalues exp(2*pi*i*j/(mu+1)),j=1,...,mu,none1. Thus ambient module has no trivial composition factor;formal Gaussian restriction to a rational seed submodule gives the contradiction without an actual-period or full image-kernel computation. Constant-coefficient differential isolation stays within original markers. Exhaustive finite-critical test:h!=0 iff(a,b,c,d,e,f)!=0;h=0 iff(e,f)!=0,(a,b,e)!=0,(d,c,f)!=0. Complementary critical conic/center-axis/hyperbola cases remain OPEN in the standalone manuscript;five other geometric families also remain. Classical Pham/Roucairol mechanisms credited;not an arbitrary nonconvergent multivariable or all-ring theorem.
